title: Deconvolve (OASIS)
description: Spikes and denoised calcium of each ΔF/F trace by OASIS for an AR(1) model (Friedrich et al. 2017), natively in both languages: c minimises 1/2 |c - y|^2 + lambda * sum(s) with spikes s_t = c_t - g c_(t-1) >= 0, g = exp(-1 / (tauDecay * frameRate)) and lambda = sparsity times the trace's noise, median(|diff(y)|) / (0.6745 * sqrt(2)).

signals.title: Traces
signals.description: Variable that holds the traces (frames x ROIs), usually ΔF/F.

output.title: Spikes
output.description: Variable the result is saved to.

denoisedOutput.title: Denoised calcium
denoisedOutput.description: Variable the denoised calcium is saved to. Leave empty to not save it.

sparsity.title: Sparsity
sparsity.description: The ℓ1 penalty on spikes, in units of the trace's noise
